role: original logical acceptance descriptions; not an engine or USD model fixture
comparison: Owner amendment 2026-10-15 to CR-TOL-001: quantities use relative 1e-6; lengths and coordinates use 0.001 mm + 1e-6*abs(expected); dimensionless frame values use absolute 1e-6 at zero and relative 1e-6 otherwise. Exact rational references are unchanged. IDs, codes, statuses, counts, strings and digests compare exactly. This is test comparison only, separate from geometry decisions/certificates. The read-only first-scope package 0.1.0 retains its older rule pending review. Decimal strings are exact references unless marked approximate; JSON numbers are nearest binary64 inputs.
quaternion_convention: orientation_xyzw = (x, y, z, w), Hamilton product, active rotation of element-local coordinates v' = q v q^-1 on the normalized accepted quaternion; world point = R(q) * local point + translation. q and -q denote the same rotation.
assembly_rule: Copy request_template, add command and arguments, then replace keys from envelope_changes; raw JSON cases bypass this assembly. For cases with argument_bindings, the future acceptance harness must first supply the actual validated resource digest; a missing binding is not a valid request. Do not substitute placeholder hashes.

cases.title: Explicit zero roll equals omitted roll
given: Authorized context; unused ID; current base/generation.
Bind a validated original immutable rectangle profile 200 x 300 mm before command assembly; no fake digest.
cases.derivation: Ideal angle reference: 0 or pi/2 is supplied as nearest f64. At zero X/Y are unchanged; at pi/2 X_r=Y_0 and Y_r=-X_0, Z unchanged. For the near-vertical Pythagorean axis use A=8000004000000, B=4000001, C=8000004000001, with A^2+B^2=C^2. The default frame has X_0=(1,0,0), Y_0=(0,A/C,-B/C), Z=(0,B/C,A/C). These exact references use CR-TOL-001, not an assertion that f64 pi/2 has exact cosine zero.
